ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure at point Q, QP is a vertically downward line segment, QR is a horizontally rightward line segment, and there is a right-angle mark between the two, indicating that ∠PQR = 90°. Ray QS is located inside this right angle, dividing the right angle into two adjacent angles: the angle near QP is labeled 51°, and the angle near QR is labeled 2. Reasoning: Because these two adjacent angles combine to form the entire right angle, 51° + m∠2 = 90°. Therefore m∠2 = 90° - 51° = 39°.
